notes.title: Update - v1.2.0 Added Weapons and Hidden Stage
notes.content:
Hello, this is Maetdol Games.  

The Hidden Stage update is finally complete!  

Thankfully, it wasn’t delayed as much as we feared.  

v1.2.0 Update Details  

[h3][b]*Major Updates[/b][/h3]  

[h3]1. Hidden Stage Added[/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/477b478008e728f76af2c8e040e240ea199b591a.png[/img]  
A hidden stage that marks the culmination of the story has been added.  
As it’s a "hidden" stage, you’ll need to meet certain conditions to access it.  
[olist]  
[*] Defeat the final boss.  
[*] Obtain the maximum amount of Nightmare Power. (It doesn't mean difficulty!)
[/olist]  
Even if you’ve already defeated the final boss, you’ll need to defeat it again.  
This is because you need to see the event that occurs after the ending credits!  

[h3]2. Conditional Doors Added[/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/23f50ae69ec18d90577557642abf6bfb1e6d7d78.png[/img]  
As shown in the development diary, conditional doors have been added.  
The name will simply be "Conditional Doors."  
These doors can be opened by meeting specific conditions or by paying a price.  

[h3]3. New Weapons Added[/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/e8087cba95be6a04636e4bfd088a3c1e764abfc5.png[/img]  
New weapons have been added: Club, Lantern, Staff, and Wings.  

[h3]4. Consumable Breakdown and Slot Expansion[/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/2ff8c336acf35b2b8c58abedcbec11277a8aea0c.png[/img]  
As shown in the development diary, consumable breakdown and slot expansion have been added.  
The existing “Disassemble” and “Tactical Pocket” contracts now include the consumable breakdown and slot expansion functions.  

[h3]5. New Totems, Sets, and Traces of Nightmare[/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/cf2b2fc5e0f39857d36881f9d89590525fdfc7e1.png[/img]  
22 new totems, 10 new sets, 4 new blessings, and 6 new curses have been added.  

[h3]6. Key Hold Attack Enabled[/h3]  
Previously, you had to repeatedly press the attack key to attack.  
This was intended to add fun through interaction and to make attacks feel more controllable.  
However, this created an issue where the maximum attack speed couldn’t be fully utilized.  
Now, you can hold down the key for continuous attacks!  
But if you take damage, you’ll need to press the key again.  

[h3]7. Improved Set Effects[/h3]  
It’s frustrating when a hard-to-achieve set effect doesn’t feel rewarding.  
The effects of some underwhelming sets have been improved.  
Some sets have been reworked entirely, while others have had their performance increased. Check them out for yourself!  

[h3]8. Damage Taken Indicator Option[/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/549f68e091836fa1dd38c2858ec62751f38a4992.png[/img]  
An option to track whether you’ve taken damage in your current playthrough or during boss fights has been added.  
- A golden heart indicates no damage taken during the entire playthrough.  
- A white heart shows no damage taken during a boss fight.  
- A red heart indicates no HP loss during a boss fight.  

We hope this helps you with achievement hunting.  
You can enable this option in the Gameplay settings.  

[h3]9. New Achievements Added[/h3]  
Several achievements related to the new stage, weapons, and codex have been added.  
We apologize to those who have already completed all achievements, but we believe new achievements bring fresh excitement. Thank you for your understanding!  



In addition to these updates, minor adjustments that do not significantly affect gameplay have been made.  
We apologize for not being able to document all the changes due to the extensive updates.  

We are also managing a **Nightmare: The Lunatic** Discord server. Please join us there!  

Nightmare: The Lunatic Discord  
[url=https://discord.gg/6hw6TTyvBg]https://discord.gg/6hw6TTyvBg[/url]  

Thank you!

notes.title: Devlog #8
notes.content:
Hello! It’s been a while since the last Devlog.

We planned to share this update earlier, but the work took longer than expected, so this log is a bit delayed.

Previously, we promised to release the hidden stage update in December, but unfortunately, the schedule has been pushed back.
We sincerely apologize to our players who have been waiting patiently.

The update is now scheduled for January, so please hang in there just a little longer!

Here’s what’s coming in the next update:

[h3]1. Hidden Stage[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/477b478008e728f76af2c8e040e240ea199b591a.png[/img]
This stage concludes the story between the protagonist and the Dream Merchant.
When the game was officially released, the current endings were intended to be the conclusion of the story. However, we couldn’t resist the urge to expand it further.
Let’s go meet the sinister Owner of The Nightmare lurking in the shadows!

[h3]2. Conditional Doors[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/23f50ae69ec18d90577557642abf6bfb1e6d7d78.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/d95c224a52146347d9e2c21a2d63df0289e60f8e.png[/img]
Doors that open when specific conditions are met will be added.
Entering through these doors will lead to new rooms where you can earn rewards or trigger events.
The official system name hasn’t been finalized yet, so for now, we’re calling them “Conditional Doors.”

[h3]3. Improved Consumable Usability[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/2ff8c336acf35b2b8c58abedcbec11277a8aea0c.png[/img]
Have you ever been bothered by items like Overheat Cores, Hourglass Sand, or Energy Batteries that seem unnecessary?
Now, these consumables can be disassembled or stored for later use!
You can dismantle consumables to gain shields or store them in a pocket for use when needed.
This isn’t a new contract but an addition to the existing contracts: Dismantle and Tactical Pocket.

[h3]4. New Weapons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/e8087cba95be6a04636e4bfd088a3c1e764abfc5.png[/img]
Four new weapons will be added!

[h3]5. New Totems / Sets / Traces of Nightmare[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/cf2b2fc5e0f39857d36881f9d89590525fdfc7e1.png[/img]
New totems, sets, blessings, and curses will be introduced.

[h3]6. New Illustrations[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/5d577d3e890aa09e6b361dfa6fe4ce8c7619866a.png[/img]
With the story expansion, we’ve also created new illustrations!

In addition to these core updates, there have been various tweaks to balance, in-game combat judgments, and convenience features.
These changes might not be noticeable enough to include in the patch notes, but we hope they make your gaming experience even more enjoyable.

We’ll work hard to complete the update as soon as possible.

Thank you!

notes.title: Update - v1.1.4
notes.content:
Hello, It's Maetdol Games.

We are currently hard at work developing the Hidden Stage update.
However, before that, we released a small update focusing on improving convenience.

Next time, we’ll greet you with a development journal regarding the Hidden Stage update. 
Thank you for your continued love and support!

Here are the patch notes for update v1.1.4.

[h3][b]*Major Updates[/b][/h3]
[h3]Improved Enemy Attack Timing Indicator[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/813c11d0aa0cb005d3e2414e2ed71acac864f9eb.gif[/img]
We’ve increased the visibility of the exclamation mark indicator above enemies' heads. 
We hope this helps new players adapt more quickly to parrying!

[h3]Hit Area Timing Display[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/947550f4baf7ddfe2bb762408ac6fdc089b72458.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/3e46a9c5ba8e68f45144ac8d5e9e97f23c80796c.gif[/img]
Now, you can check attack timing through Hit Areas. 
While this may make the game easier, we believe fair battles are more important.

[list]
[*] You can now see the attack timing through the Hit Area.
 - Some boss attacks will still require you to learn the timing without Hit Areas.
[/list]

[h3]Added Restrained Mechanic[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/f939da8e796ba71d8f1b5722937b49509e6845ef.gif[/img]
We've added a new "Restrained" status for the next update.
It won’t appear too often, though.

[list]
[*] A new Restrained status effect has been added.
 - You can't ignore Restrained attacks with Dash, but you can parry them.
 - You can break free by alternating left and right key presses.
[*] The trap stingray’s bubbles have been changed to Restrained attacks.
[/list]

[h3]Improved Projectile Hit Detection[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/666f9856af615e43bfcaadb9a3b70405688ec59c.gif[/img]
Projectile hit detection has been improved.
We hope this makes using projectile weapons a bit more viable.

[list]
[*] Projectiles that are not fired downward will no longer be blocked by platforms.
 - Of course, they will still be blocked by the ground.
[*] Fixed an issue where projectiles would sometimes get stuck on walls.
[/list]

[h3]*Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the circular effect was not displayed when enemies were hit by an overloaded revolver attack.
[*] Fixed an issue where the piercing effect was not displayed when enemies were hit by an overloaded Sniper Rifle: Penetrator attack.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Bow: Storm's Arrows copied by the Totem: 'Kaleidoscope' wouldn’t bounce off walls.
[*] Fixed an issue where the effect of the Noble's Cloak was not displayed in the status window and buff icon.
[/list]

[h3]*Erosion[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the probabilities for Erosion ranks.
 - The probability of high-rank Erosion increases through Nightmare Analyzer: Erosion Enhancement.
 - Increased the probability of special Erosion.
 - Increased the probability of Double Erosion.
[/list]

notes.title: Update - v1.1.3
notes.content:
Hello, It's Maetdol Games.

Here are the patch notes for update v1.1.3.

[h3][b]*Major Updates[/b][/h3]
[h3]Contract Additions and Adjustments++[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/9718dd0c6fd0106b78e9f20675969f7bee98a6dd.png[/img]
We are making one last adjustment to the contracts!
We felt that meeting the reforging system, one of the main systems of the game, was happening too late, so we made some changes.
The name of the existing 'Reforger' contract has been changed to 'Shop Reforger', and a new 'Reforger' contract has been added.

[list]
[*] The name of the existing 'Reforger' contract has been changed to 'Shop Reforger'.
[*] A new 'Reforger' contract has been added.
  - Install Reforger in the "Lupine Forest".
[/list]
The efficiency of Totem: 'Sweet Apple' is so good that other active totems are not being used.
To improve this, a new contract 'Tactical Pocket' has been added.

[list]
[*] Added the 'Tactical Pocket' contract.
  - Store one more Active Totem.
[*] Modified the effect of the 'Veteran' set.
  - The effect of the 'Tactical Pouch' contract is the same as the 'Veteran' set, so the effect has been modified.
  - Active Totems have a 50% chance to recharge back to 100% on use. In this case, totems that are consumed on use will not disappear.
[/list]
Finally, we have adjusted the order and price of the contracts!

[list]
[*] The contract order has been adjusted.
  - 1st row: Sweet Apple, Healing Fountain, Totem Vending Machine
                   -> Sweet Apple, Healing Fountain, Item Inverter
  - 2nd row: Item Inverter, Starter Pack, Synthesis Machine
                   -> Reforger, Totem Vending Machine, Starter Pack
  - 3rd row: Dismantle, Reforger, Nightmare Extractor 
                   -> Nightmare Extractor, Dismantle, Synthesis Machine
  - 4th row: Nightmare Analyzer, Recycling Machine, HP Stand
                   -> Nightmare Analyzer, HP Stand, Tactical Pocket
  - 5th row: Selection Vending Machine, Discount Event
                   -> Shop Reforger, Recycling Machine, Discount Event
  - 6th row: Selection Vending Machine
[*] The contract prices have been adjusted.
  - Healing Fountain: 10 -> 5
  - Item Inverter: 25 -> 15
  - Totem Vending Machine: 15 -> 10
  - Nightmare Extractor: 50 -> 40
  - Nightmare Analyzer: 75 -> 60
  - HP Stand: 50 -> 40
[/list]

[h3]Added Enemy and Statue Collection[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/d2615656c111c0e79e2ff2c1998d48ba40be185e.gif[/img]
The collection now includes tabs for enemy and statue.
You can keep a record of defeated enemies and used statues.
Check out the stories about the enemies and the detailed effects of the statues!

[list]
[*] Added an enemy tab to the collection.
[*] Added a statue tab to the collection.
[/list]

[h3]Pause During Boss Battles[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/8878b436abca52cc08a2b4e8f6db1a7d00f19f4e.gif[/img]
You can now pause and resume during boss battles.

[h3]Random Weapon Adjustment[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/d1322313176b0683bb425b18f097f5aef8abc25a.gif[/img]
The random weapon selection has been changed to weapon selection.
Of course, you can still choose weapons randomly!

[h3]Added Statues[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/87b51910d78df685288556fb6a3d8c13d284e8f6.png[/img]
Two new statues have been added.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

notes.title: Update - v1.0.5 Difficulty Adjustments, System Improvements, Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello, It's Maetdol Games.

Reported bugs have been fixed and easy/normal difficulty has been adjusted.

About v1.0.5 updates.

[h3][b]*Major Updates[/b][/h3]
[h3]Difficulty Adjustment and Sweet Dream Mode Added[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/381ab514b0023617fb4a798c549715ce877d471b.png[/img]There was a lot of feedback that the Normal was difficult for light users.
We thought it would be hard to learn the game if the Difficulty was high for the first time, so we adjusted the Difficulty.
The sooner you get used to the game, the more fun you will have!
[list]
[*] Easy: Deleted
 -> Added 'Sweet Dream' mode
 -> Sweet Dream mode can be applied at any Difficulty.
 -> If Nightmare Difficulty is too hard, challenge with a sweet!
[*] Normal: Adjusted
 -> Enemy ATK decreases and attack delay increases compared to Hard.
 -> The boss attacks more slowly and discontinuously compared to Hard.
[*] Hard: Added
 -> Same as the last Normal
[/list]The last Normal has been adjusted to Hard, and the new Normal has been adjusted to a difficulty level between Easy and Hard.
Instead of deleting Easy, we added 'Sweet Dream' mode.
The difficulty level above Nightmare remains the same!
We hope more players find the game enjoyable and see the end of it!


[h3]Remove The Last Frame From The Player's Room[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/a97041aed099e15f20cafae35be9e38c5fa85a5a.png[/img]The Last frame in the player's room has been prepared for content to be added later.
So it's natural that it won't open, but we didn't think it would confuse players.
We have deleted it to avoid further confusion.
We are very sorry for any confusion!


[h3]Weapon Balance Adjustment[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/89ff7f6e9d78ff0e9961283e76c36b9c1a7fdf9f.png[/img]The Shield's swap buff was created with the intention of parrying by swapping weapons, and it was confirmed to work as intended.
However, we also felt that it made the game a little easier.
Therefore, the function will be maintained, but the duration will be modified so that it should be used with more timing.
[list]
[*]Reduced Shield's swap buff duration
 -> Duration: 6 seconds -> 4 seconds
[/list]The Greatsword's SP Attack is slow and difficult to hit, but it only cost 20 SP, so the damage is low.
SP cost has been increased to 30 and damage has been increased to make it easier to inflict damage.
[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/3729bfb6b7fd6d9558807ab7e7a8601feb5d4626.gif[/img]There was an opinion that it was boring because there was no reward after defeating the boss.
The boss reward can actually be obtained from Boundary Shelter, but we thought that opinion made sense.
So we added a little reward!
[list]

 -> Low probability of dropping a Dream Shard Box
 -> Golds, Dream Shards, Artifact Fragment drop
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/c03268df8dc74f0dd988a94203ab181971a0d7c8.png[/img]It would like to fill out the collection, but there was an opinion that it would be difficult because it can only be viewed in the player's room.

notes.content:

Of course, you will have to check for attacks that do not display area yourself!

[h3]Improved Bosses[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/93e0e96a0aca043d86fb206bc37ed9f297756c1a.gif[/img]

notes.title: Nightmare: The Lunatic Official Release!
notes.content:
hello. This is Maetdol Games.

[h3][b]Nightmare: The Lunatic has finally been official released![/b][/h3]
We were able to come this far thanks to the love and feedback we received during the early access.

There are many things we would like to develop in the future.
So please give us lots of love.
The more love there is, the more content there is.
[b]Please spread the word about the official release![/b]

If you encounter any issues while playing, please report them through the Steam community or our official Discord. 
We will work to address them as quickly as possible!

[h3][b]1. About Early access save data[/b][/h3]
Retained: [b]Totems, Contracts, Abilities, Dream Shards[/b]
Reset: [b]Weapons, Event progress[/b]

Totems, Contracts, Abilities, and Dream Shards will be retained, but Weapons and Event progress will not.
Please understand that it has been reset due to changes in the save method and unlock method.

Starting with the full version, you can view statistics and play history within the game.
Unfortunately, it is impossible to check because the early access version did not have a recording function.
Please take note of this.

[h3][b]2. About Language[/b][/h3]
The languages currently supported are Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
We wanted to re-support all the languages that were supported in the early access period, but circumstances made it impossible...
We apologize to players from various countries who may have been waiting.
Still, [b]we plan to support all of them again someday, so please wait a little longer![/b]

[h3][b]3. Major Updates[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added ‘Sanctuary of Gladiators’ stage 
[*] Added story and ending
[*] Added Weapon Reforging
[*] Added Nightmare Analyzer
[*] Added Nightmare difficulty 
[*] Added 7 weapons
[/list]For more information, please refer to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1842730/view/5799014051067709946]here[/url]!
In addition to the major updates above, updateds are as follows:
[list]
[*] Added ‘Dream Crystal’ for contract
[*] Added ‘Artifact Fragment’ for ability
[*] Added achievements
[*] Added Totems
[*] Added Traces of Nightmare (Blessing/Curse)
[*] Many other modified Totems, Traces of Nightmares, Weapons, etc.
[/list]
There are many small fixes.
Even early access players, please enjoy the game as if it is your first time!


After a long early access, it has finally been officially released.
It took longer than expected, but we have no regrets because we did our best to make a fun game.
Please enjoy Nightmare: The Lunatic.
Thank you!

Best Regards,
Maetdol Games.

notes.content:
[h3]Hello. This is Maetdol Games.[/h3]
It's been two years since Nightmare: The Lunatic entered Early Access.
Between unexpected development changes and the addition of multiple systems, it's taken us longer than we thought.
But now we're really close to the full release!
There were many moments when we wanted to give up, but thanks to the people who love our game, we've made it this far.
We'll continue to work hard on the remaining content, and we can't wait for you to see it in full as soon as possible!


[h2]1. Official Release Date[/h2]
[h3]We expect the official release to be [b]late February - early March.[/b][/h3]
We should be able to give you an exact release date [b]sometime in February[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/186432acc301e7a7fe6adcf799a3e91ed56444ab.png[/img]
Will the player be able to escape this terrible nightmare?
You can find out for yourself.


[h3]Reforging[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/f3377918683e09d943393fb4a22a406dd9960ed8.png[/img]
Reforging completely changes some of a weapon's abilities.
Try using the same weapon in a new way.


[h3]Nightmare Analyzer[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/5775972f2735715193bdf6944cd68aeb079b4f56.png[/img]
When you've been in a nightmare this long, you should know how to use it to your advantage.
The Nightmare Analyzer allows you to enhance your weapon erosion.


[h3]Nightmare Difficulty[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/74bbbbf9a47462d45412c11963a67f9a950471a2.gif[/img]

In addition, Totems, Sets, and Traces of Nightmare (blessings/curses) will be added.
Stay tuned!


[h2]3. Price Increase[/h2]
[h3]Price increased: $14.99 -> [b]$16.99[/b]
Increase schedule: 2024-01-21 07:00 (PST)[/h3]
As planned in Early Access, we've added a lot of content, which has resulted in a price increase.
The current price for each country is based on the Steam Suggested Price at the start of Early Access.
However, when we raise the price, the new Steam Suggested Price will be applied, so some countries may see a large price change.

Here's how you can give us some love!
[list]

Please show us some love and support so that we can continue development after the full release...!


[h3]It's a new feeling to write a full version announcement.[/h3]
When we started development, we didn't know when we'd finish, but now we can see the end.

notes.content:
Hello! This is Maetdol Games.

We share the development status with you!

*In progress
[list]

[*] [strike]Additional Elite Bosses[/strike] - (Changed)
  -> Additional Bosses
[*] Story elements
[/list]
We're changing systems and planning.
We hope it becomes a more fun game!

Here are some new updates!

[h3]1. System changes [/h3]
We're telling you this because the most basic system of the game is scheduled to change.
Planned system changes include:

[b] - Added Select player ability
 - Gem charging when parrying, SpAttack gauge charging when changing weapons: Changed from basic ability to optional ability[/b]

  The current tutorial explains so many functions that it is difficult to learn all of them even after completing the tutorial. Weapon Change, SpAttack gauge charging when changing weapons, Change Buff, parrying, gem charging when parrying, etc...

We decided that it would be difficult for players to realize all of these functions on their own without explanation, so we included them all in the tutorial. However, this seems to have made it more difficult to learn the most basic functions (dashing, parrying, weapon change, etc.).

We determined that the cause of this was too many base abilities. Since you have additional functions that are added to the basic functions from the beginning, it is difficult to learn them in order.

[b]So, we plan to change it so that players can select and acquire additional functions.[/b]

Of course, simply changing these additional functions from basic abilities to optional abilities would simply increase the number of steps you have to go through, so we plan to provide more options.

Currently, the additional functions are focused on weapon change play (which we recommend), but we want to expand the range of options to allow for a variety of play styles.

We hope these changes make it easier for players to get into Nightmare: The Lunatic!


[h3]2. Stage 5 Boss[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/0026f7263512d018690a186db2f4646f388fac8d.gif[/img]
  This is Stage 5’s boss, Regina, Empress of the Arena! Development is currently being finalized. We can’t wait to fight too!
But it looks like an outfit I've seen before somewhere... It's probably a coincidence, right?


[h3]3. Additional Weapons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/845b3ef069d630438ca52ac9f02fe1e35e30c3da.png[/img]
We are revealing the weapon design that will be added in the next Update. You might know the concept of the weapon right away when you see it. We won't give any further explanation. haha.


We're working hard to make the game better.
We ask for your interest and support!

Thank you!

Hello.

It's been a really long time since the last update!
There are quite a lot of changes, so [b]we would appreciate a lot of feedback![/b]

[b]The event and tutorial progress has been reset.
All other data remains intact.
This is not a bug, so please do not reset your data!
Resetting will delete all of your data!![/b]

Added Traditional Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, and Spanish.

Stage 4 will be added in the next update due to sound-related issues.

About v0.1.10 update.

* Bug fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where button images were not visible in the weapon selection UI in the first playthrough weapon swap type selection screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where HP recovery was possible through weapons with Corrupted effect on Max HP increase.
[*] Fixed an intermittent issue where the player was not visible.
[*] Fixed an intermittent issue where trigger effects based on the number of hits were not applied.
[*] Fixed an intermittent issue where zombies in Stage 1 stopped moving.
[*] Fixed an issue where even if the invincibility shield of the snake priest in Stage 2 disappeared, the enemy's invincibility was not lifted intermittently.
[*] Fixed an issue where the head thrown by the bomber in Stage 3 intermittently stopped moving.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cold bullet effect of the Don Sagnan did not disappear intermittently.
[/list]

* Gameplay
[list]
[*] The tutorial has been revamped. Try playing the new tutorial!
[*] Dialogue for each event has been revamped.
[*] Camera movement has been improved. You can see smoother transitions.
[*] The option to decrease attack speed of enemies in Easy mode has been removed.
[*] Now, if you lose the effect that increases Max HP, your current HP will be reduced by that amount.
[*] A time-based wave has been added to wave rooms.
[*] The number of rooms in the entire stage has decreased.
[*] Achievements have been added.
 - Some Achievements have rewards, so be sure to check them out!
[*] The Player room have been added.
 - Currently, it doesn't have any functions, but we plan to allow you to check your collections and statistics in the future.
[*] The Shelter has been added between each stage.
 - The boss reward chest has been removed (changed to Elite-only).
 - The Health Shelf has been moved to the Shelter.
 - Boss rewards other than money can now be obtained in the Shelter
 - After defeating a boss, the amount of HP recovered has increased.
[*] Unlock prices have increased.
[*] Contract prices have increased.
[*] The default pad key for inventory has changed.
 - LT -> L3
[*] An Active Totem Swap key has been added.
 - Default pad key: LT
 - Default keyboard key: B
[*] The dialogue skip key has changed.
 - SpAttack key -> Cancel key
[/list]

* Weapons
[list]
[*] The Overload has been modified.
 - The Overload gauge can be used when it is 35% or more full.
 - If the gauge is full, it lasts for 10 seconds, and otherwise it lasts for current gauge / max gauge * 8 seconds.
[*] The initial delay for the basic attack of the bow has been reduced.
[*] The change buff for the revolver has been changed.
 - Shoots bullets with default attacks -> A friend that shoots bullets follows you with default attacks.
[*] The initial delay for the recovered after throwing all orbs has been reduced.
[*] The ATK of the spear's default attack has been reduced, and the Attack Spd has been increased.
[*]The Overload effect of the spear has been changed.
 - Short charge -> SpAttack enhancement (SpAttack gauge is automatically charged, cost is reduced, and enemies hit with SpAttack are pulled along).
[/list]

* Enemies
[list]
[*] All enemy HP and ATK have been readjusted. We appreciate your feedback on this change!
[/list]

* Bosses
[list]
[*] All boss HP and ATK have been readjusted. We appreciate your feedback on this change!
[/list]

* Totems
[list]
[*] The damage of Totem: Exploding Seed has been decreased.
[*] Totem: Golden Sun Shield has been changed from attack-type to HP-type.
[*] The effect of Totem: Steel Boots has been changed.
 - Ignore floor damage -> 50% decrease in floor damage.
[*] Now, acquiring a Hourglass Sand with a stackable active totem will fill the stack completely.
 - Totem: Empty Bottle, Totem: Donation Box (before use)
[*] 40 new totems have been added.
[*] Totem: Cube of Meat and Totem: Butcher’s Knife have been removed from the Set: Gourmet.
[*] The effect of Set: Best Friends has been modified.
 - 30% increase in friend ATK and size -> 30% increase in friend size, 15% increase in friend ATK per friend.
[*] Totems that are included in the set have been added. It may be easier to achieve the set.
[*] Three new sets have been added.
[/list]

* Objects
[list]
[*] Now the Dream Merchant perform actions during conversation.
[*] A synthesis machine has been added. It can be unlocked through a contract.
[*] Two new statues have been added.
[*] The design of the stage portal has been changed.
[/list]

* UI 
[list]
[*] The overall UI design has been changed.
[*] Now, the icon above the player's head will only be displayed if the buff effect is either ATK, Attack Spd, or Move Spd, or if it is a debuff.
[*] New languages have been added:
 - Chinese Traditional, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, and Spanish have been added.
 - There may be untranslated parts depending on the development progress.
[*] The position of the timer has been moved below the HP bar.
[*] The cooldown for passive totems is now displayed above the SpAttack gauge instead of above the HP bar.
[*] The quality of the text showed has been improved.
[/list]

* Sounds
[list]
[*]The sound effects for enemies and bosses in Stage 3 have been changed.
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello! It's Maetdol Games.

We wanted to do an update this week, but it took a long time due to a lot of interconnected systems...
We will try our best to update next week at the earliest or the week after next at the latest.

[h2]1. In Development[/h2]
[h3]1-1. Stage 4[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/8aef9ee9d1bef5cfe10b8cd83ee5efe636a5892e.gif[/img]
  We have completed the implementation of all enemy patterns in Stage 4 and are currently working on level design and sound effects. Without a sound designer, sound work is always difficult and time consuming.

[h3]1-1. Stage 4 Boss[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/781248cb5fbb146032681de3ff9857940ebfea45.gif[/img]
  We are creating a boss resource. It was designed with the concept of a test subject and a butcher. It looks like it will take quite some time to finish working on the resource.

[h3] 1-3. Stage Map Structure[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/f471789dc3c26d306d7a34613f70f57b49e1bb69.png[/img]
  The Healing Fountain appears as a separate room instead of the shop. Each question mark room type is identified by an icon. These rooms now appear in locations other than the end of the map. We are currently modifying the map structure to make it more natural. Hope your map exploration is a little more fun!


[h2]2. Improvement Plan [/h2]
[h3]2-1. Tutorial[/h3]
  We've been constantly tweaking Tutorial before and after the early access release, but making Tutorial intuitive and effective is still a long way off. Nevertheless, we believe that we are continuing to improve and would like to improve once again. We hope this will be the last time...


[h2]3. Etc.[/h2]
[h3]3-1. Totems, Weapons and Achievements[/h3]
  We're introducing a system where achievements unlock totems and weapons. As such, new totems and weapons will be updated after the achievement system is implemented. Some of the totems that exist in the current build may be modified to be unlocked through achievements. Of course, for those who have already unlocked it, the unlock will be maintained even if you do not complete the achievement. We will develop achievements ASAP for new totem and weapon updates!



We will work hard to make the game more fun.

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hello! It's Maetdol Games.

The development and update of previously planned content is over, and the recent update cycle is gradually increasing due to new content planning and stage 4 development.

As a result, users waiting for the official release were also tired, and we, who used to only communicate through updates, felt the need for improvement, so we wrote a Devlog! 

In the past, we showed the development stage in progress through the update preview, but we will visit the Devlog more frequently.

And to strengthen communication with users, we have prepared Discord Server. This enables real-time feedback delivery and response. We look forward to your participation!

Nightmare: The Lunatic Discord [url=https://discord.gg/6hw6TTyvBg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/0b07e812a233d064e2440419fe38f2290e3152b0.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/6hw6TTyvBg]https://discord.gg/6hw6TTyvBg[/url]

As this is the first Devlog, we tried to include as many contents as possible.

[h2]1. In Development[/h2]
[h3]1-1. Stage 4[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/4ecb04522a2ae62dc91862395bfcc05683760977.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/3e27cefd1c5e882c713daa501c7acca556c7a948.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/d51e80908d2d52c6d36b04e2b24eb0a47b0b38e9.gif[/img]
  It's been 4 months since the last update preview. Since our game is currently in early access, we prioritized making the planned system work properly, and as a result, the schedule for adding content was delayed a lot. Nevertheless, we have been developing it from time to time, and now we are spending quite a bit of time on Stage 4, so we would like to carefully tell you whether it will be possible to update before the end of November. As we said before, the concept is a living laboratory + panopticon, and subjects appear as enemies!

[h3] 1-2. Added Corrupted Options and Increased Corrupted Chance[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/00def6c690de7db27937810064bb087f6c7670ad.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/24c563f898657d60c687c4c051cbaa63f7d519f2.png[/img]
  Some of you may or may not have seen these weapons while playing the game. It is a Corrupted weapon that is currently dropped with a low chance. unlike normal weapons, it has additional effects. The effect currently added is a simple stat increase such as increased attack power, but special options for each weapon will be added. For example, as an option for the Corrupted hammer, an effect such as 'Increases damage by 3x when only one enemy is attacked with the hammer's Spattack' is applied. We are also developing an object that uses Dream Shards to increase the drop chance of Corrupted weapons.

[h3] 1-3. Totems[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/c98d7c445ffbb8c07aa7dd49f631add2ce972ead.png[/img]
Totems are a key growth factor for Nightmare: The Lunatic, so we think we need a lot of them. Resources for the planned totems are produced and will be added slowly!


[h2]2. Improvement Plan [/h2]
[h3]2-1. Stage Map Structure[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/64be4da9d2345d492bd73dcd7112308d933d8e44.gif[/img]
  When playing the game, with the exception of the room located at the end of the stage map, all of them consist of a normal room where you have to fight, so we think it makes players feel tired. And, because the only definitive means of recovery before you find the store is to clear the room, and the fountain's role is duplicated because you can purchase health recovery items in the shop, so we'll remove the fountain from the shop and assign it to on one of the rooms that composes the stage. In addition to that, to reduce fatigue, we want to add a non-combat room in a non-end room location.

[h3]2-2. Totem Drop Chance and Growth value[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/598caad1b792a50f80e80643943a44dcea8a50f0.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/cd00a67adf0d9ef99a357c099bb1f7dcbc209664.png[/img]
  Totems, as mentioned above, are a key element of growth. However, with the exception of totems (boss chests, treasure chests) that can be definitely acquired in the current game, most of them are acquired from shops. We believe this reduces the fun of earning rewards in the game, increases reliance on gold, and tends to make it too easy for players to get stronger by choosing the totems they get. Also, the basic effect of totems is strong, so the difficulty of the game is reduced too much when many totems are acquired. To improve this, we would like to apply the following modifications.
[olist]
[*]Increase the total number of totems
[*]Modification of the ratio between totem types 
(the ratio of the number of attack type, health type, and special type, currently about 2 : 1 : 1)
[*]Modification of growth values through totems
[*]Increase drop chance and add ways of acquisition (event room, etc.)
[/olist]
Details will be decided through additional planning, and if there is an opportunity, we will disclose it in the Devlog. We hope the game becomes more fun!

[h3]2-3. Traces of Nightmare[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/ed1456838cc8bb479faba99abf90bea4d8603d64.png[/img]
  Traces of Nightmare is a high-risk and high-return item that we wanted to work as a factor that makes players contemplate whether to acquire it or not. But now we're not sure... we don't think it's working very well, so we need other opinions. First of all, we plan to improve in the direction of greater risk and return. Please feedback on the current Traces of Nightmare system!

[h3]2-4. Overload[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/9be76cb56559c15c886467f559d7854c3f3fd679.gif[/img]
  Overload is an ability you use to instantly increase your dps. It's good to use in boss fights, but in the end it feels like it's only used once in boss fights. We want to improve the ability to use overload at a certain gauge or higher so that you can choose to use it once for a long time or use it frequently for a short time. Depending on this, the overload of weapons may be renewed!


[h2]3. To Be Added[/h2]
[h3]3-1 Additional Weapons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/735c80ed6faf85714caf95f64c69053187006279.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/816389643cfe7fd2d561b48dbe5d82d0c9756eea.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/3ade1e146ef0dc98919c63ac3c21ee2929491f89.gif[/img]
  It will be developed after stage 4 development.

[h3] 3-2 Dream Corruption - Nightmare Piece, Enchant Corruption[/h3]
  It's a new system. Manage the Corrution rate to play stably, or clear Corrupted rooms for additional rewards. You can obtain a new money, Nightmare Pieces, by it. The Nightmare Pieces will be used to enchant a weapon with Corruption. Of course, there will also be a way to enchant Corruption to weapons.

[h3] 3-3 Achievements[/h3]
  We plan to proceed with development at the same time as Stage 4 development has progressed to a certain extent. It will also be linked with the unlocking of totems and weapons.

We will continue to work hard in the future, so please give us a lot of interest and feedback.

notes.title: Update Preview
notes.content:
Hello.

Originally, the update was supposed to go this week, but the update was delayed due to participation in the event.

We apologize for the schedule delay.

Instead, we would like to share the things that will be updated in the future.

[b]1. Permanent Generator pattern renewal [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/ea4a94e41dc24ee46162c94254aa0ac9d82c7107.png[/img]

  Permanent Generator is a boss designed with a focus on the fun of dodging. It was designed so that players can focus on dodging when they can't attack, and when they can attack, they can focus on attacking without worrying about evasion.

   However, it is thought that the Permanent Generator is working in a markedly different way from the planned intention. Not only does it put too much stress on the player, but the pattern itself doesn't feel very interesting.

  We would like to improve this part and proceed with the renewal in a way that can provide fun according to our planning intention. This will be implemented in the near future.


[b]2. Totem balancing and renewal[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/25ffd64715c5fb16f276bf7b23aa2977895b5332.png[/img]

Totems are items that strengthen the player and are one of the core fun elements of our game. Some totems simply increase stats, while others have unique effects that make gameplay more enjoyable.

The current totems are not very well balanced because they were planned in the early development of the game. Therefore, the balance of the totem will be modified to maintain the pleasure of getting a good totem, but not to over-destroy the balance.

And since various systems have been added compared to the early days of the game, we want to utilize them more. We plan to change the effects of some totems for you can play in a different way than before when you acquire certain totems.


[b]3. Set Effect[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/3e5a3284fc53e6f0b445277b7753c14225f9b74a.png[/img]

We shared it in the preview of the last update, but the schedule was pushed back. But we will definitely update it!


[b]4. Switch Procon and DualShock support[/b]

Currently, only the Xbox controller is natively supporting(with UI). Other controllers can only be used using the Steam controller settings. To solve this inconvenience, we plan to support other controllers (including UI button images) to be used without Steam controller settings.


[b]5. Stage 4[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/caebb693bc09e02378d38ac7bcce71cadd2fe135.png[/img]

Planning is complete and resources are being created. It will probably take quite some time to update. The concept of stage 4 is a panopticon and a living experiment!


[b]6. New weapons and totems[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/05e1a24167a4728fdee359fb726ff9507a96fd08.png[/img]

Weapons and totems, which are the core of the game, are always contemplating. Concept planning for new weapons has been completed, and it is planned to be updated after stage 4. Totem will be updated from time to time as resources are completed!


[b]7. Steam API integration[/b]

This is what we said in the preview last time, but like the set effect, the schedule has been delayed. Achievements, Steam Cloud, etc. will be supported. We plan to work on the above contents from time to time while developing them.


We will work hard until the official release.
Thank you!

notes.title: Update Preview - Future Development
notes.content:
Hello.

We're sorry we haven't been able to tell you for a while.

We are aware that the game has small contents, and we have been focusing on development for a while to address this.

As the development of Stage 3 has progressed to some extent, we're here to show you how the game will be updated in the future!

We have a plan that update Stage 3 within February, and starting with this, we plan to add a lot of content and renew other parts that are not very fun.

Currently planned update elements include:

1. Stage 3 Update

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/5a28731a4971f71180ef0979e34034a7244a6168.png[/img]
A 'City of Glory' with a brilliant mechanical civilization is added to your nightmare! Machines that suffered from constant labor fought against humans and achieved a revolution. Fight the machines attacking you and find your way.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/302246ee2abe14a2bd96f91703a911768447971d.gif[/img]
But be careful. The leader of the Machine City and the great revolutionary 'Don Sagnan' may stop you.


2. Stage 1, 2 additional enemies, additional room design

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/12a85f0b60e0613bcdd0d8fadb0b07089419e7cc.png[/img]
For the diversity of enemies in Stages 1 and 2, we plan to add one enemy each. We also want the rooms on the stage to feel new with every play, so we will continue to increase the number of room.


3. Visual update

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/5b6a98200529df64071178dff26e68343909c5ba.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/4ec9f78d2f6dda38abb84bab760cea8eec7110aa.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/f0f1698e0e6e3e26a7fcbed62bfa5ee2c89ed578.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/b1b8656963cc3b446b2bff9475ddaac6a40f5079.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/6103e68041a658a3e5ac9c42b74e2c6cd2c32598.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/b1f01c3b0d70ed112242e65f08ca37333ec57da0.png[/img]
We'll be updating the visuals so that the objects you see on each stage look more natural. A background object will be added and the background will be partially modified.


4. Change BGM
We outsourced the BGM for the game. BGM will be updated whenever you receive a result!


5. Weapon Renewal - Bow
Bows are powerful one-shot ranged weapons, but they tend to be too unusable. We plan to renew the weapon to improve usability while keeping the concept alive.


6. Add Weapon - Orb

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/af60ff59099657df954b02f4db637d2892c2ef76.png[/img]
New weapon will be added. Orb is a weapon with strong destructive power, although it is difficult to link with other weapons. Try using the Orb by selecting the weapons that will help the Orb!


7. Traces of Nightmare Renewal

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/a1daf0793699003e4db5e6c36978c6df7014ea37.png[/img]
Currently, the traces of the nightmare are thought to be mere manipulation of stats. It will be renewed so that players can think more about it in the face of high risk and high return. And to make it fun to watch.


8. Dream Manipulation
This is a new element designed to give players a different experience with each iteration. Don't tamper with your dreams. A strange force may be at work on you!


9. Set Effects

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635418/3e5a3284fc53e6f0b445277b7753c14225f9b74a.png[/img]
To make collecting totems more attractive, we're going to apply totem set effect.


10. Achievements (Steam Achievements)
We want to inspire players to take on a challenge by adding an achievement system. It will also be linked with Steam achievements.


11. Steam Cloud
We will provide Steam cloud, which is not currently available.


After stage 3 update in February, we plan to develop and update it step by step.

We will work hard to make the game even more fun.

Thank you!
